description: Benin - Electricity Transmission Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Daniel Paco (ECREEE). A Benin subset of this dataset: ECOWAS region - Existing and Planned Transmission Grid (2017) Existing and planned transmission grid network (medium and high voltage lines) in the ECOWAS Region. Also covers other regions of West Africa. The source of the dataset is the West African Power Pool (WAPP) GIS database January 2017. Coverage: Benin. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, ZIP. The portal files it under Energy access, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
